outcome: reasons for attendance to the gynecological emergency room (GER)
cohort: This study included all women who attended the GER within 6 weeks after birth between January 1, 2016, and September 30, 2016.
finding: Postpartum women are at risk of morbidities, especially following cesarean sections and in women with hypertensive disorders during pregnancy.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth was significantly associated with GER attendance (38.7% vs lower rate in those with vaginal birth, p < 0.001).
